about_the_game:
"Gods Deify War" is a mythological action level-clearing game rooted in the "Investiture of the Gods" lore. You will step into the Fengshen battlefield amid the transition between the Shang and Zhou dynasties, and in a mythical world overrun by monsters and disrupted heavenly order, carry on the legend of Fengshen as a heroic figure.

There are various monster enemies everywhere here: from fox demons with sharp claws, mountain spirits with immense strength, to Shang army vanguards holding shields and resisting stubbornly, Jie Jiao disciples proficient in evil arts, and even bosses like Daji who enchants all living beings and Shen Gongbao who is well-versed in magic. Every battle is a double test of strategy and operation. You can control Fengshen heroes such as Ne Zha and Yang Jian, use the Wind-Fire Wheels for long-range bombardment, and the Three-Pronged Two-Edged Sword for close-range consecutive slashes, breaking through the siege with the combination of exclusive skills and moves.

The game features diverse levels. Scenes such as the ruined farmlands on the outskirts of Chaoge, the immortal secret realm of Kunlun Mountain, and the ancient battlefield of Mengjin hide mechanisms and traps. To clear the levels, you need to combine combat skills with scene exploration. At the same time, you must collect resources such as spiritual energy crystals and healing immortal herbs, upgrade heroes' attributes and skills, and unlock innate powers like "Lotus Rebirth" and "Xiaotian Dog's Assistance" to defeat monsters with strength and advance the cause of Fengshen.

  • It adopts the classic level-clearing mode: each level has an independent scene and objective, ranging from cleaning up monsters on the outskirts to challenging the boss at the pass. Scenes switch continuously as the plot progresses, and the complexity of mechanisms and the strength of enemies gradually increase, bringing a progressive sense of challenge.

  • Flexible 3D character control: You have full control over the 3D Fengshen heroes, smoothly performing basic actions such as walking, jumping, and dodging. You can also actively launch combo attacks and release exclusive ultimate skills like "混天绫 Strangulation" and "Heavenly Eye to Break Evil". The operation feedback is accurate, and the combat excitement is full;

  • Level venue resource mechanism: Each level venue contains abundant resources. You can not only search for immortal herbs to replenish health and spiritual energy crystals to level up, but also find exclusive magic treasures such as Tai Chi Diagram Fragments and Qing Shi Pipa, which help to quickly strengthen the heroes' abilities and lay the foundation for subsequent boss battles;

  • Time-limited level rules: All levels have a time limit. If you fail to eliminate the specified monsters, defeat the level boss, or complete designated tasks such as escort and mechanism cracking within the specified time, you will fail to clear the level, creating a strong sense of urgency.

content_descriptors.notes: WARNING: This game contains strong language and extreme violence.

Players control Fengshen heroes to traverse Shang-Zhou battlefields, use exclusive skills to fight monsters and bosses, collect resources to upgrade abilities, and unlock divine powers to continue the Fengshen legend.
